name: Raijin
title: Herald of Storms
summary: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: Demon-god of the tempest, Raijin delights in devastation. Although driven by both his own nature and by rage at Izanagi, Raijin still feels some sense of ownership over Izumo. He often directs his storms against the realm’s enemies, not to spare his own people suffering—he still batters them fiercely—but because he feels Izumo is his to harrow, no one else’s.
